description:
Neon White is a speedrunning FPS puzzle platformer made by freaks for freaks.
Rush through a series of levels making smart use of your restricted cards to clear heaven of demons.

v0.2.0.description:
*Looking for the Neon White mod? Find it [here!](https://github.com/stxticOVFL/NWArchipelagoMod/releases/latest)*
*Compatible with v0.2.x of the NWArchipelago mod.*

- ### **Card abilities can now be split across missions!**
	- Abilities can be set to either:
		- unlock **per in-game mission** (e.g. Rebirth - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level that is in Rebirth in the base game), which is **currently the new default**, 
		- unlock per **generated mission** (e.g. Mission 1 - Elevate (Fire) to get it for every level in your *own* Mission 1), 
		- or keep them **global** (e.g. one Elevate (Fire) for the whole game).
	- You can also set certain cards to be **forced to be global** on the mission settings (e.g. it defaults to Katana and the Book of Life being 1 item each for the whole game.)
	- Additionally, some cards are now marked as *Useful* instead of *Progression* when they aren't logically relevant, and only cards that appear in those missions will appear in the item pool at all. 
- Level Randomization has been tweaked to make for better progression!
	- Levels now properly take into account all the items you would have to clear every check in that level, and influences other levels that are similar to it to be closer to it.
	- The **Level Selection Variance** setting acts very similar still, with 0% meaning it will guarantee levels in a linear order, and 100% being very random. The **default for this setting was changed** to *30%* down from *50%*.
- The **Starting Level Count** setting has been changed to go off of total check counts for your starting items. 
	- Previously, it only added starting levels that were guaranteed to be completable to your max medal, and would not select any levels that don't have gifts. 
	- This change was made to prevent restrictive starts even harder, and should make the start of the world more open. Thus, the **default for this setting was changed** to *3* down from *5*. Most settings couldn't reach 5 starting levels that fit in the criteria anyway.
- New filler items have been introduced to help any potential filler feel less repetitive.
	- Added items: Garbage, Book of Death Page, Cloud 9 Minigolf Ball, Neon Mask, Secret of Heaven.
		- All of these are referenced in voiced dialogue!
	- (Hopefully with all of these changes, you won't be seeing that much of these anyway!)

## APWorld-Only Changes
- **Universal Tracker is now** (actually) **fully supported!** (and I actually tested it this time)
	- This includes **yaml-less, glitched logic, custom location sorting that fits your mission order, and shiny new `/explain` for relevant checks!**  
- There are now **option groups** that helps keep the options in the launcher's options creator nice and categorized/sorted!
- An absurd amount of internal restructuring that makes for both less fill errors and faster fill!
	- Neon Ranks outside of the % required are classified as Useful for item filling. They're turned back to Progression in post fill (keeps UT in check and makes spoiler log generate faster).
	- A custom rule builder rule class has been made to check rules faster than before, including its own caching system which especially helps for worlds with multiple Neon Whites.
	- There is now a custom fill hook that places items inside the progression item pool in a way that speeds up gen and helps the generator get less stuck.
	- Fuzzer meta files have been added to the repo for checking progress against the fuzzer tool:
		- [`fuzzer_default`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_default.yaml) checks against most of the default settings. (**100%!**)
		- [`fuzzer_player`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_player.yaml) checks settings that are within reasonable ranges and probabilities for most people who play this APWorld. (**~100%!**)
		- [`fuzzer_all`](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/fuzzer_all.yaml) just ensures the goal condition is set to `3bosses` to help limit the amount of ignored results. (roughly **98%** success rate!)
- Various other changes were made to ensure we pass all unit tests!
	- (except for the memory leak test: there are no problems when actually generating (including no-output), but specifically the test doesn't appear to like it.)

### **Check the [game info](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/docs/en_Neon%20White.md) and [complete setup guide!](https://github.com/Badhamknibbs/ArchipelagoNeonWhite/blob/main/worlds/neonwhite/docs/setup_en.md)**
